scope_note: The Schedule II partial-fill and transfer group, repaired after the V7 round and re-sealed at content versions 6, 5 and 7. SG-FED-MA-INTERACTION was restructured inside its declared scope and MA-Q-0009 was removed from it, because that question needs drug schedules, prescription-monitoring and CMEA content the section does not teach. Seven additive rules carry the added law. Scope-gate signals were reviewed and declined: the transfer-record rules surface only because the remainder rule cites 21 CFR 1306.08 and 1306.25, and transfer mechanics are the declared subject of SG-CIII-V-REFILL-TRANSFER; the out-of-state rules are the declared subject of SG-MA-OUTSTATE-PRESCRIPTIONS; Schedule VI rules have no place in a Schedule II lifecycle; the prescription-format rules belong to the oral and Schedule VI sections; FED-CIII-V-REFILL duplicates FED-CS-REFILL-III-IV; and FED-CORRESPONDING-RESP is not a refill or transfer limit.
